The team project is the capstone of the course — and the only piece of fully
open-ended work. In teams of **3–4**, you'll propose and build an ambitious,
real-world project of your own design, applying every workflow skill from the
semester: version control, planning, skills, automation, debugging, continuous
integration, deployment, and (where it helps) multi-agent orchestration.

Throughout the final weeks, class sessions become **team work sessions** where the
instructor circulates, audits progress, and gives direction — and where we learn
collaboration workflows (pull request reviews, issues, and fork → branch → merge)
live, as you need them.

**Summary of deliverables:**

-----|--------|-----------------
